title: RCSE v1.1.0 — full-population selective execution study
description: Reproducible full-population and matched-natural selective execution study, including all eligible source cases, repeated independent calibration, sequential risk selection, an earlier fixed-90-day temporal refit, nonlinear safety estimation, exact cost break-even curves, consequence sensitivity and source timestamp audits. Manuscripts, reviewer correspondence and document-editing helpers are excluded. Original code is MIT licensed; source-data attribution remains CC BY 4.0.
